name: slot10-war-room
description: Sleeper NBA draft overlay and Lock-In coach for NBA League Revamped (slot 10).

scripts.test: node tests/test_engine.js && node tests/test_fit.js && node tests/test_lock.js && node tests/test_bridge.js && node tests/test_ui.js && node tests/test_season.js
scripts.render: python3 tests/render_ext.py 29 drafting clock && python3 tests/render_ext.py 40 drafting wait && python3 tests/render_season.py
scripts.package: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/war-room-extension && cp -r extension/* dist/war-room-extension/ && cp reports/top120.md reports/top120.csv dist/ && cd dist && zip -qr slot10-war-room-v$npm_package_version.zip war-room-extension top120.md top120.csv
